name: mantaprint-hub
changelog: Drivers & devices: the technical apt package list is replaced by 'Supported printers & scanners' grouped by brand with Printer/Scanner badges, a filter and a search box; 'Install support' fetches the packages a family needs in one go. System packages live under a small 'Hub tools' list.

Fix: Drivers & devices jobs (apt install, .deb install, HP firmware upload) failed with 'Unexpected error' after the actual install succeeded, because the post-install printer re-sync called a misnamed helper.

Lockdown mode (print-only): an nftables firewall that leaves only IPP 631/tcp and mDNS reachable, admin web only from listed admin IPs, SSH optional from the same list, outbound limited to DHCP/DNS/NTP/mDNS, cups-browsed disabled. Switch in the TUI (Diagnostics > 9) and Admin > Settings; turning it off needs the lockdown PIN (default 1234). Scanning, the homepage, updates and MantaPool are blocked while it is on, by design.
